method: Wash and dry the rocket and tomato; shred the leaves and slice the tomato thinly. Reserve most of the leaves and any excess tomato for a side salad so the wholemeal bagel can close.
Use chilled, already-cooked turkey breast; slice it thinly or shred it into small pieces. Keep it refrigerated until assembly.
Use the measured tikka yoghurt as a ready-to-eat sauce or dressing; stir in all the measured olive oil. Keep chilled sauces refrigerated until assembly.
Split the wholemeal bagel. Toast the cut halves lightly if desired, then let them cool slightly before filling.

Combine the prepared filling with the measured tikka yoghurt and olive oil dressing. Add a small handful of the prepared leaves and some sliced tomato. Put a manageable layer of filling on the lower bagel half and add the top. Serve all remaining filling and vegetables alongside as the side salad.
Eat now, or put the meal and any side salad into a covered container and refrigerate promptly. Eat within 24 hours and follow any shorter ingredient use-by date; keep it chilled until eating.
